panels.title: Needs you
panels.description: Stuck: a Kaizen task waited over 20 minutes for a machine. For you: held changes and questions in the Control room. Flight tracker: the public API serving live aircraft.

panels.title: Beelink
panels.description: Whole machine, CI VMs included. CI VMs: Firecracker VMs running, out of 5 slots by default, the standby included.

panels.title: Security
panels.description: CrowdSec: addresses blocked now, and whether its engine and firewall bouncer are working. Bans by reason are under Security detail.

panels.title: Backups
panels.description: Off-site restic backups to R2: successful runs in 26 hours (no run alerts at 26 hours), failed or skipped in 7 days, size stored. Deep checks are under Backups detail.

targets.expr: max(max_over_time({container_name="backup"} |= "repository size:" | regexp "repository size: (?P<bytes>[0-9]+) bytes" | unwrap bytes [26h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Alerts
panels.description: Every alert rule not currently OK; empty means all is well. All alerts go to Discord and the Claude triage routine.

panels.title: CPU, cores in use
panels.description: Stacked, in cores: Docker containers, the Firecracker CI VMs, and the rest of the machine (system, Tailscale, the CI supervisor). The dashed line is all 4 cores.

panels.title: Container CPU
panels.description: Each Docker container's CPU, % of one core, 5-minute average.

panels.title: Memory in use
panels.description: Stacked: Docker containers, the Firecracker CI VMs, and the rest of the machine. Page cache the system can free is not counted. The dashed line is all memory.

panels.title: Container memory
panels.description: Each Docker container's memory in use.

panels.title: Kaizen
panels.description: Working: tasks an agent or CI is on. Waiting: queued for a machine (homelab or GitHub's). Merged and cost count since midnight UTC.

panels.title: Kaizen wait for a machine
panels.description: The longest any running Kaizen task has waited for a Firecracker CI machine. Over 20 minutes alerts (the red dashed line).

panels.title: Kaizen tasks by state
panels.description: Counts in the Control room, every 30 seconds.

panels.title: Alerts
panels.description: Every alert rule not currently OK; empty means all is well. All alerts go to Discord and the Claude triage routine.

panels.title: CPU Over Time
panels.description: max by (name) collapses duplicate series from scraper restarts.

panels.title: Memory Over Time
panels.description: max by (name) collapses duplicate series from scraper restarts.

panels.title: CI VMs running
panels.description: Firecracker VMs on the Beelink for every repo, out of 5 slots by default; one is usually a standby.

panels.title: Deep Checks Passed (8d)
panels.description: Each Sunday the run downloads and verifies every stored byte.

targets.expr: max(max_over_time({container_name="backup"} |= "repository size:" | regexp "repository size: (?P<bytes>[0-9]+) bytes" | unwrap bytes [1d]))
{container_name="backup"} |~ "backup ok|backup FAILED|backup SKIPPED|repository size|snapshot .* saved|deep check|Fatal"
